public_rationale: He says most of the hundreds of billions of dollars of GPUs sold were sitting uninstalled when he wrote. Microsoft's CEO said in late 2025 that some chips were in inventory and could not be plugged in for lack of power. A later report says Amazon stored billions of dollars of Nvidia racks without power in mid-2026. Neither gives an industry-wide share, and neither falls in the weeks before the post. No public source I found measures how much of the GPU value sold was installed versus waiting around March 2026. So the evidence cannot show whether 'mostly' is true or false.
limitations: Industry-wide deployment data is not public.
The context reports are secondhand news and fall outside the target period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Most of the hundreds of billions of dollars of GPUs sold are sitting uninstalled.

statement.excerpt: Hundreds of billions of dollars of GPU sales are mostly sitting waiting for somewhere to go.
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: Hundreds of billions of dollars of GPU sales
our_interpretation: Plain reading: when the post went up, more than half (by dollar value) of the hundreds of billions of dollars of AI GPUs already sold had been delivered to buyers but were not installed and running in data centers.

He names no period. He describes a present state, so the target period is the weeks just before the post date (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-24). It is not swapped for Nvidia's fiscal quarter that ended in January 2026.
'GPU sales' is read mainly as Nvidia data center GPU sales, since Nvidia is most of the market. 'Mostly' is read as a majority by value.
criteria.support_condition: Credible evidence, such as company disclosures, hyperscaler statements, or independent deployment counts, showing that in or around March 2026 more than half by value of the AI GPUs sold were still uninstalled or not powered on.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence showing that in or around March 2026 most AI GPUs sold, by value, were installed and running, with only a minority waiting for space or power.
